YOUR GLOBAL CLASSROOM AWAITS!
A. Take your education beyond borders with our Japan Study
Abroad Program (Japan SAP).
B. Earn college credit while exploring a land that blends ancient
traditions with cutting-edge innovation.
C. This program is designed for college students seeking cultural
immersion and intellectual growth.
D. The Japan SAP complies with university study-abroad policies
and is fully accredited for transfer credits.
Program Highlights:
• Tokyo: Engage in lectures on global business and technology
while experiencing vibrant city life.
• Kyoto: Study Japanese history and art surrounded by temples
and gardens.
• Hokkaido: Learn environmental science through hands-on
activities in stunning natural landscapes.
Why Choose This Program?
• Faculty-led courses and expert local guides
• Flexible itineraries aligned with your academic goals
• Affordable student pricing and scholarships available
• Seasonal options include winter break and spring break sessions
Language support ensures a smooth experience.
Apply now! Visit www.japansap.jp or call 940-555-1234 for details.
